method: Independent visual audit only under owner instruction2026-11-09; all272 current PNGs inspected using20 labeled HTML/Compose comparisons plus58 four-configuration state contact sheets. audit_limitations: Static JVM Roborazzi images demonstrate pictured visual states, not TalkBack announcements, physical touch accuracy, IME avoidance, focus return, live network behavior or device rendering.
The source and every PNG hash were checked current; tests/code review are separate QA evidence and do not determine visual judgments.
No pixel-identity claim: system-font rasterization, HTML review chrome, fixture names/counts/time/message text and conditionally enabled capabilities are documented separately.
AUD-05 records a conflict between written pane-width tokens and relative HTML rendering; it is retained as deviation rather than silently granting an exception.
